image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a small mustelid (likely a ferret or polecat) peering out from under a dark, textured overhang (possibly wood or stone). The animal has a cream/white face with dark markings around the eyes and nose, and a darker brown/black body. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the face while the body fades into shadow. The foreground is blurred, creating a shallow depth of field.

Both eyes are visible, appearing small, dark, and bead-like, consistent with the taxonomy.
The ears are visible on the sides of the head, appearing short and rounded, matching the description.
